pairs.why: Both keep the same deep red booth, mid-green wall and lime floor, so color gives no clear reason to choose.
A has neutral grey stone with small saturated accents, like the real lighthouse and sandcastle cards, while B is a mostly mauve-purple mass that is louder and more one-note.
B's fabric is a deeper, richer forest green with peach-pink shadow tint, closer to the real chair than A's brighter lime fabric.

B's gold has deeper brown-orange shadows and a darker, moodier background edge like the real brass lamp and jellyfish cards, while A's light lavender background and flat yellow gold are louder and washed out.
The two chairs have nearly identical green fabric, steel tubes and red-orange gradient, so color does not separate them.
A's green stripes are calmer and the orange rim is a bit deeper, while B has a loud yellow-lime glow and hotter orange that go well past the real minty green.
A's stone is a slightly more lavender-grey and its grass shadows are deeper green, like the real card, while B's stone is more neutral grey.
A's fabric is deep green and its floor shadow is peach-pink, near the real chair, though its lime piping adds an extra accent.
